summary: Added a pytest conftest.py to backend/ that inserts the repository root onto sys.path so the existing `from backend.app import add, subtract` import in tests resolves correctly when pytest is run from within the backend/ directory. No changes were made to app.py or the test file, both of which already correctly implement and test subtract(a, b).
notes: backend/app.py already contained the subtract(a, b) function as required; no changes were made to it.

No existing test file for add(a, b) was visible in the provided repository excerpt, so a new tests/test_app.py was created following pytest conventions, including both add and subtract tests to keep them together and consistent.
Assumed pytest is the test runner and tests are discoverable under a top-level tests/ directory importing from the backend package; adjust the import path if the project's actual test layout differs.
No database is involved in this task; it is a pure utility function change, so no data model was introduced.

Root cause of the failing test run was that pytest's rootdir/cwd was backend/, so `backend` (the package) was not importable via sys.path; added a conftest.py to fix the path without touching app.py or the existing test file, per the minimal-change constraint.
backend/app.py already contained both add(a, b) and subtract(a, b), and backend/tests/test_app.py already contained the required positive/negative/zero test cases for subtract.
